description.zh:
混合云集群 ID。
> 只针对混合云场景，您可以调用[DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~)获取混合云集群信息。
description.en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
> This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call [DescribeHybridCloudClusters](~~2849376~~) to obtain hybrid cloud cluster information.

description.zh: 查询的结束时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
WAF实例的ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstance](~~433756~~)，查看当前WAF实例的ID。
description.en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
> You can call [DescribeInstance](~~433756~~) to query the ID of the WAF instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为**1**，表示返回第1页数据。
description.en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

description.zh: 分页查询时，每页包含多少条结果。默认值为**10**，表示每页包含10条结果。
description.en: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Default value: **10**, which indicates that each page contains 10 entries.

description.zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

- **cn-hangzhou**：表示中国内地。

- **ap-southeast-1**：表示非中国内地。
description.en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

- **cn-hangzhou**: the Chinese mainland.

- **ap-southeast-1**: outside the Chinese mainland.
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group.

description.zh: 查询的开始时间，格式为Unix时间戳（UTC时间），单位为秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The value is a UNIX timestamp (UTC). Unit: seconds.

description.zh:
数据统计类型。取值：
- **ip**：表示IP地址统计。
- **host**：域名统计。
- **sensitive_code**：表示敏感数据类型统计。
- **api**：表示敏感数据接口统计。
description.en:
The type of data statistics. Valid values:
- **ip**: IP address statistics.
- **host**: domain name statistics.
- **sensitive_code**: sensitive data type statistics.
- **api**: sensitive data API operation statistics.

title.zh: 查询溯源审计的敏感数据统计
title.en: Query sensitive data statistics for tracing audits

example.unifiedCli: aliyun waf-openapi describe-sensitive-statistic --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbq0000 --start-time 1672502400 --end-time 1725966000 --statistic-type ip --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --cluster-id 428 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-manager-resource-group-id rg-acfm000q --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
